summary: OpenAI announced it will wind down its contract supplying OpenAI models to Cursor following Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX, with a proposed shutoff date of November 12, 2026.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI is withdrawing model access from a widely used developer product, removing a channel of inference volume.
mechanisms.quote: Today, we notified SpaceX that we intend to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff date of November 12, 2026.

practices.reason: Developers building on Cursor with OpenAI models have a fixed deadline to migrate off OpenAI-backed functionality before the contract ends.
practices.quote: Today, we notified SpaceX that we intend to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff date of November 12, 2026.

notable_reason: OpenAI is publicly terminating access to a major third-party developer product over compliance concerns tied to Elon Musk-owned entities, a significant and unusual partner rupture in the AI developer tooling ecosystem.
